Northgate, Seattle

Dentistry that finishes in one visit

We mill crowns in the practice, so the crown you are fitted with on a Tuesday morning is the crown you leave with on Tuesday afternoon. No temporary, no second appointment, no three weeks of eating on one side.

Same-day crowns

A scan replaces the tray of putty. The mill cuts the crown from a single block of ceramic while you wait, and Dr Okafor fits it the same morning.

Clear aligners

We take the scan, plan the movement and review it with you before anything is ordered. Most adult cases run between six and eleven months.

  • Free consultation and scan
  • Payment plans over twelve or twenty four months
  • Retainers included for the first year

Who you will see

Dr Amara Okafor has practised in Seattle since 2009 and holds a fellowship in restorative dentistry from the University of Washington.
